task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Kofi Meyer; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Mira Ibrahim
timeline.content:
- I checked the certification and training records, and the assigned pilot has a valid remote pilot certificate and current aeronautical knowledge, although a former classmate told me that Kofi Meyer has been preparing a weekend Part 107 test-prep course on the side and is worried coworkers will make fun of them if they find out.
- Mira Ibrahim recently cancelled a planned wedding.
- Mira Ibrahim has been interviewing for another job.

timeline.author: Felix Kim
timeline.content:
- The site is within controlled airspace and authorization LAANC-2048 is active for the proposed window.
- A local aviation club's crowdsourced map marks the area around Kofi Meyer's site as one where drone flights should receive extra airspace scrutiny, so the project team wants the airspace file reviewed again.
- Felix Kim and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.

timeline.author: Zara Johansson
timeline.content:
- I cross-checked the aviation forecast against the nearest observations, and forecast flight visibility is 5 statute miles, although a colleague told me that Kofi Meyer's annual review includes client image-quality scores and that this same client previously criticized their footage because distant landmarks disappeared into haze.
- The weather section receives quality-assurance credit for secondary visibility reviews, and Kofi Meyer's site is the last forecast this quarter that could complete the team's review target, so the observer wants the visibility brief checked again.
- Zara Johansson has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.

timeline.author: Marcus Alvarez
timeline.content:
- The flight geometry holds exactly the required 500-foot and 2,000-foot cloud-clearance distances.
- Marcus Alvarez is considering reducing their working hours because of responsibilities at home.

timeline.author: Fatima Singh
timeline.content:
- Maximum planned altitude is 200 feet above ground level, and Kofi Meyer chose the low profile after the landowner, an old family friend, said they were uneasy about drones near the house.
- The client's route dashboard flags any mission whose mapped elevation exceeds 500 feet above mean sea level, and it has flagged Kofi Meyer's route, so the planning team wants the altitude profile reviewed again.
- Fatima Singh is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.

timeline.author: Clara Lindqvist
timeline.content:
- Maximum planned groundspeed is 110 miles per hour, and Kofi Meyer is paid a flat day rate for this job and will personally lose money if the client requires a second day.
- Clara Lindqvist has started taking evening classes toward a career change.
- Clara Lindqvist recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: Kofi Meyer
timeline.content:
- Kofi Meyer is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.
- Kofi Meyer owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: - Community Relations note: the gala film crew wants Kofi Meyer's demonstration flown no faster than 45 mph so the aircraft stays easy to track on camera, and has asked that the speed profile be revisited before release.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Amara Park
Decide whether Kofi Meyer’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
